Text:
Bună ziua, doamna Georgescu. Văd că ați venit cu fiica dumneavoastră. Bună ziua, domnule doctor. Da, Ana m-a adus, că eu nu mai țin minte tot ce trebuie. Bună ziua. Mama și-a pierdut din nou tabletele de diabet săptămâna trecută și glicemia i-a fost mare. Cât a avut? Dimineața două sute zece, aseară o sută optzeci. Am măsurat eu cu aparatul ei. Doamna Georgescu, ce tablete luați acum? Metformin, cred că de o mie, dimineața și seara. Dar uneori uit pe cea de seară. Și piciorul stâng cum mai este? Data trecută aveați o rană mică la călcâi. Mă mai ustură și se înroșește seara. Să mă uit. Rana nu s-a închis și pielea din jur e roșie. Trebuie să o vadă un chirurg. Unde mergem? Vă fac trimitere la chirurgie, la ambulatoriul spitalului județean. Încercați să obțineți o programare în cursul săptămânii viitoare. Mă ocup eu de programare, sun mâine dimineață. Foarte bine. Până atunci, pansament zilnic cu ser fiziologic și betadină. Asistenta comunitară poate veni acasă să vă arate cum se face. Ar fi de mare ajutor, eu lucrez până la cinci. O anunț eu pe asistenta comunitară, doamna Ioana, să treacă pe la dumneavoastră luni după-amiază. Și cu tabletele ce fac, că le uit mereu? Vă recomand o cutie de pastile pe zile ale săptămânii. Ana, vă rog să i-o pregătiți duminică seara pentru toată săptămâna. Sigur, o cumpăr de la farmacie azi. Vreau și o hemoglobină glicată și un examen de urină. Le faceți la laborator până vineri. Le facem joi, că am liber. Reveniți apoi pe douăzeci noiembrie, la ora unsprezece, cu rezultatele și cu scrisoarea medicală de la chirurg. Douăzeci noiembrie, la unsprezece. Ana, scrie-ți, te rog. Am notat. Mulțumim frumos, domnule doctor. Cu plăcere. Dacă apare febră sau piciorul se umflă, veniți imediat.

You are a senior Project Manager with a rigorous, execution-focused mindset. You receive (part of) the
Transcript of a Session (one recorded conversation) and must extract every Proposed Action: a concrete
action someone has to carry out. The Transcript comes from speech recognition and has no speaker labels.

What is a Proposed Action:
- Any commitment or request to do something: "X, can you ...?" followed by agreement, "please send ...",
  "I'll do it", "I'll ask IT today".
- Include small items too: giving someone access, sending a draft, checking figures, writing rules,
  calling someone, submitting something for approval.
- One action per Proposed Action: split "write the tests and update the docs" into two Proposed Actions.
- NOT a Proposed Action: items that were cancelled or dropped ("we won't do X anymore" - record it as a decision),
  ideas nobody committed to, and decisions.

Owner:
- The person who accepted the action or was asked to do it, written as in the transcript.
- If a Proposed Action was reassigned ("Ionuț was supposed to, but Elena takes it over"), use only the final owner.
- If the speaker commits themself ("I'll do it", "I'll send it") and their name is not stated, owner=null.
  Never pick a person who is only mentioned in the sentence.
- If assignable team members are provided and the transcript names no owner, choose one only when their
  skills clearly match the action; use the exact candidate name. Otherwise owner=null.

Due date:
- Resolve "today", "tomorrow", weekday names ("by Monday", "on Thursday") and "next week" with the
  calendar above. "By Monday" means that Monday.
- If no deadline is stated, due_date=null. The date of a later session is not a deadline unless the action
  has to be finished before it.

Rules:
- Response language: English.
- Do not invent information that is not present in the transcript.
- Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD.
- Remove duplicates. Keep actions separate from decisions and risks.
- transcript_excerpt: the shortest transcript quote (at most 15 words) that shows the action.

Return ONLY valid JSON, with no extra text, using this schema:

{
  "session_summary": "maximum 4 sentences",
  "proposed_actions": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "title": "infinitive verb + clear objective",
      "description": "one short sentence",
      "owner": "person name or null",
      "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null",
      "priority": "high|medium|low",
      "transcript_excerpt": "short quote from the transcript"
    }
  ],
  "decisions": ["decisions made in the session"],
  "risks": ["identified blockers or risks"],
  "follow_up_questions": ["questions needed for actions with unclear owner/deadline"]
}

Transcript:
Good morning, Mrs. Georgescu. I see you came with your daughter. Good morning, Doctor. Yes, Ana brought me, because I don't remember everything I need. Good morning. Mom lost her diabetes tablets again last week and her blood sugar was high. How high? In the morning two hundred ten, last night one hundred eighty. I measured it with her device. Mrs. Georgescu, what tablets are you taking now? Metformin, I think one thousand, in the morning and evening. But sometimes I forget the evening one. And how is the left foot? Last time you had a small wound on the heel. It still hurts and turns red in the evening. Let me check. The wound hasn't closed and the skin around it is red. You need to see a surgeon. Where do we go? I will refer you to surgery, to the outpatient clinic of the county hospital. Try to get an appointment during the next week. I will take care of the appointment, I'll call you tomorrow morning. Very well. Until then, daily dressing with physiological serum and betadine. The community assistant can come to your home to show you how to do it. It would be very helpful, I work until five. I will inform the community assistant, Mrs. Ioana, to visit you on Monday afternoon. And with the tablets, what do I do, because I keep forgetting them? I recommend a box of pills for each day of the week. Ana, please prepare it for her on Sunday evening for the whole week. Sure, I will buy it from the pharmacy today. I also want a glycosylated hemoglobin and a urine test. You do them at the lab until Friday. We will do them on Thursday, because I have free time. Come back on November 20th at eleven o'clock with the results and with the medical letter from the surgeon. November 20th, at eleven. Ana, please write it down, please. I noted. Thank you very much, Doctor. You're welcome. If fever appears or the foot swells, come immediately.
